set.body:
Deliver the fixed-release and grant-management portion of D11 using the existing server grants, recipient lookup and effective-access endpoints.

Acceptance criteria

1. A steward can select a named recipient and opt into release-scoped discovery. Link-only reading and discovery-only access remain explicit choices with an accurate preview of what the recipient can see.
2. Opening the access screen in another browser or as another authorized steward retrieves current grants, scope, expiry and revocation state from the API. Browser storage cannot serve as the authoritative grant list.
3. The recipient sees a discoverable release on Home and can open only the permitted scope. A link-only share stays absent from Home but permits the authorized direct read.
4. On a lost-response retry the form reuses the same intent key. Following a revocation it refreshes effective access and identifies any separate remaining basis.

Verification

Packaged two-account browser cases including fresh sessions, concurrent independent grants, expiry, retry and revoke. D11 retains the selection-to-subset dialog.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: ARC07: Show the live grants and let a steward choose discoverable or link-only sharing
